scope: Pure .NET natural resources, trust and digestive health; no game or visual acceptance. Intervals are Wilson 95% game sampling diagnostics, not medical estimates.

first-food-choice.scope: Matched initial need, one near meal beside a continuously engaged hand, one farther leaf patch in the opposite direction. This controlled layout does not imply all low-trust oil always chooses leaves.
